walkthroughs.body_html: The Moon is tidally locked — its rotation matches its orbit. So we always see the same near side from Earth.
Bright highlands are old and cratered. Dark maria are huge lava plains formed billions of years ago.
From 1969-72 12 astronauts walked on the Moon during the Apollo programme. They brought back 380 kg of Moon rock.
